name: 伊妮德
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_五_晚祷下.md:332
who: Enid, a human locksmith's apprentice of the east bank of the ford city, fourteen but looking about twelve: a small child, about 146 cm, thin and small, wholly covered by her clothes. Black hair chopped short in a ragged mess, cut by herself with the shears she uses for lock springs. Brass-coloured eyes, the same colour as her keys, narrowed when she looks at a lock and wide open when she looks at people. She wears a robe far too big for her, the sleeves rolled three times and the hem dragging on the ground; across the front a bunch of keys that chime with every step. A quick, restless, mischievous air. No glasses, no jewellery.
palette: brass and gold, black, worn brown wool, steel grey, a little rust
casual: Her master Wenzel's old robe, a drab brown wool robe far too big for her, closed down the front with buttons, the sleeves rolled up three times, the hem dragging; a dozen small pockets sewn inside it; across the chest a bunch of keys on a ring, a coil of fine steel wire and seven picks in a roll; a small copper listening tube in one hand. Soft boots too big for her. She has no weapon at all. A bright, quick look.
private: A plain long-sleeved wool tunic to the knees over wool leggings, house shoes, the big robe left off; a brass key held up in one hand. She stands, a sleepy, contented look.
battle: The oversized robe belted tight with a cord, the sleeves pushed up, the hem knotted up, a leather tool roll at her side; a copper listening tube in one hand and a thin steel pick in the other, eyes narrowed, mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the working outfit: standing with the head tilted, the copper listening tube raised to her ear in one hand and a thin pick in the other, the eyes narrowed and fixed, the mouth closed; she carries no weapon.
formal: A clean dark-green wool dress with long sleeves and a white collar, the key ring polished and hung at her waist on a ribbon, the black hair combed flat for once, the big robe folded over her arm. She stands straight with the hands folded, a proper, slightly impatient look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the brass eyes wide open and looking straight at the viewer, mouth closed, an alert, quick look, the ragged black hair messy around her face. Warm lantern light from one side, brass glints from the keys. Foreground blur: a ring of keys swinging into the frame. She wears the oversized brown robe.

name: 伊妮德·九日之锁
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_五_晚祷下.md:984
who: Enid, a human locksmith who became a legend of cleverness without ever fighting, looking forty-seven: about 150 cm, small and slight, quick-handed. Black short hair, still cut ragged, now threaded with grey. Brass-coloured eyes. She still wears her master Wenzel's robe, far too big for her, the sleeves rolled three times, a bunch of keys on the chest that chime with every step. Fine laugh lines at the eyes. She talks very fast, nine sentences in ten finished at speed, the tenth trailing off sideways. A sharp, mischievous air. No glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: a small sharp adult face of about forty-seven, brass-coloured eyes with fine laugh lines at the corners, black ragged short hair with grey strands, thin brows, a quick half-smile; keep the same flat anime style.
build: 150 cm, small and slight, narrow shoulders, a small bust, a slim waist, lean strong hands.
palette: brass and gold, black and grey, worn brown wool, steel grey
casual: The same oversized drab brown wool robe of Wenzel's, buttoned down the front, the sleeves rolled three times, the hem dragging, full of inner pockets; the bunch of keys across the chest, a roll of steel wire and picks, a copper listening tube in her hand. Soft boots. No weapon. A quick, clever look.
private: A plain long-sleeved wool dress to the shins with a leather apron, house shoes, her sleeves still rolled; a lock held in one hand and a rag in the other. She stands, a dry half-smile.
battle: The big robe belted with a cord, the sleeves pushed up, a leather tool roll at her side, the copper tube in one hand and a thin pick in the other, the brows drawn together.
battle_pose: 3) the working outfit: standing with the copper listening tube raised to her ear in one hand and a pick in the other, the eyes narrowed and fixed, the mouth closed, already knowing the answer; she carries no weapon.
formal: A clean dark-green wool coat over a white linen blouse, the old robe folded over one arm, the key ring polished and hung at the waist, a neat grey-streaked head. She stands straight, hands folded, a dry, patient smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face unchanged by years but the brass eyes carrying them, looking at the viewer with a quick, knowing half-smile, mouth closed. Warm lantern light from one side. Foreground blur: a ring of keys swinging into the frame. She wears the oversized brown robe.

name: 安瑟姆·雾桥
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_五_晚祷下.md:388
who: Anselm Mistbridge, a human squire of the lake kingdom, sixteen: about 186 cm, tall and long-limbed, still thin, wholly covered by his clothes. Hair the pale colour of lakeside reeds, thick darker honey-brown brows, honey-amber eyes that look at a person as if waiting for them to strike first. His face has not yet filled out, a few soft downy whiskers on the chin he has shaved twice. His hands are covered in blisters from spear practice. A serious, dutiful, earnest air.
palette: reed gold, lake blue, white ash wood, steel, a little silver
casual: His squire's clothes: a deep blue wool tunic with a ring of embroidered water at the cuffs, a leather belt, dark trousers and boots; a white ash-wood spear in his right hand; on his left arm a tall tower shield with a blank empty face (on the viewer's right when they face us); on his back, slung, a second shield painted with a ring of lake and a single star. A serious, earnest look.
private: The blue tunic loose over a long-sleeved cream linen shirt, rolled sleeves, soft boots, no shields; a hot bun held in his hands. He stands, a tired, shy look.
battle: A boiled leather cuirass over the blue tunic, leather vambraces, a plain steel cap, the white ash spear held level in both hands, the blank tower shield on his left arm (on the viewer's right when they face us), the painted star-lake shield slung on his back; feet planted, a stern look.
formal: A long deep blue wool surcoat to the knee, embroidered water at the collar and cuffs, a silver clasp at the shoulder, a lake-blue ribbon tied at the throat, the spear held upright beside him and the painted shield carried on his back. He stands straight with his chin raised, a grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the honey-amber eyes under thick brows looking straight at the viewer as if waiting, mouth closed and firm, a very serious expression. Cold pale lake light from one side. Foreground blur: the blank face of a tower shield at the edge of the frame. He wears the blue squire's tunic.

name: 雷米
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_五_晚祷下.md:444
who: Remy, a dog-eared beastkin boy of the north bank of the ford city, a guide of the unlit lantern, fourteen: about 150 cm, small and thin, wholly covered by his clothes. A messy shock of sandy-gold hair, large drooping dog ears set on top of his head (one ear pricks up when he is listening) and no separate human ears at the sides of the head. Amber eyes that sweep a whole room before he steps into it. He carries an unlit lantern that he keeps only so those who follow him know where he is. A quiet, alert, watchful air.
palette: sandy gold, amber, grey wool, rope brown, dull white
casual: His guide's clothes: a plain grey wool hooded jacket and trousers patched at the knees, a rope belt, soft boots; in his right hand an unlit lantern on a short chain; a white ash walking stick tucked under his arm; a coil of rope tied at his waist. He carries no blade. A quiet, watchful look.
private: A loose long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, rolled brown trousers, soft shoes, no jacket; the unlit lantern held in both hands in front of him, one ear pricked. A sleepy, listening look.
battle: The grey hooded jacket buttoned up, the hood down so both ears show, leather gloves, the rope coil in one hand and the unlit lantern in the other; he has no weapon. Feet light, a tense, listening look, one ear pricked.
battle_pose: 3) the guiding outfit: standing leaning slightly forward, one ear pricked high, the unlit lantern held out at the end of one arm and the other hand holding a rope behind him, the eyes wide and alert; he carries no weapon.
formal: A clean dark-blue wool jacket with brass buttons over a white linen shirt, tidy trousers and polished boots, the sandy-gold hair brushed flat, the unlit lantern held neatly in front. He stands with both ears down, a polite, wary look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned a little aside, one dog ear pricked and the other drooping, the amber eyes glancing at the viewer from the corner, mouth closed. Pale fog-blue light from one side. Foreground blur: drifting fog and the unlit lantern at the edge of the frame. He wears the grey wool hooded jacket.

name: 柯黛
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_五_晚祷下.md:500
who: Cordai, a deer-eared beastkin courier of the Feather Letter Society, forty-three: about 168 cm, tall and slender, long-legged. A pair of long slim deer ears with white tips set on top of her head, and no separate human ears at the sides of the head; the back of her left ear (on the viewer's right when they face us) has a notch from an arrow that once grazed it. Cream-coloured short hair that blows backward in the wind. Pale amber eyes set wide apart, looking not at a face but to both sides. A quiet, watchful, unhurried air. The two deer ears grow from the TOP of the head and stand upright, pointing up and slightly outward like a deer's, NOT hanging down from the sides of the head at eye level; the notch cut into the back edge of the left ear (on the viewer's right when they face us) is clearly drawn in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: an adult woman of about forty-three, pale amber eyes set wide, faint fine lines at the corners of the eyes, a calm composed mouth, a lean face; keep the same flat anime style.
build: 168 cm, tall and slender, long-legged: lean shoulders, a B-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: cream and pale amber, grey cloak, deerskin brown, white feather
casual: Her courier's clothes: the Feather Letter Society's long grey cloak with a single white feather pinned at the collar, over a plain grey wool tunic and close-fitting trousers; a letter satchel slung across her back, lying flat; thin-soled deerskin shoes worn almost through. She carries no weapon. A calm, listening look.
private: A loose long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, soft trousers, bare feet, no cloak; the worn deerskin shoes held in one hand. One ear turned aside, a quiet, faraway look.
battle: The grey cloak thrown back, the satchel strapped tight to her back, a leather cap tied under the chin, leather gloves, thin deerskin shoes laced tight; empty hands, no weapon. A lean, intent look, the ears flattened back.
battle_pose: 3) the running outfit: standing in a ready stride, the ears flattened back, the satchel strapped tight, the arms bent ready to run, the eyes fixed ahead; she carries no weapon.
formal: A clean long grey cloak with the white feather at the collar over a dark wool dress with long sleeves, a silver clasp, polished leather boots, the satchel held in front in both hands. She stands tall and still, a composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the ears upright, the pale amber eyes looking slightly past the viewer to both sides, mouth closed in a calm half-smile. The cream hair blown back by a cold wind, pale dusty daylight from one side. Foreground blur: a single drifting grey feather. She wears the grey cloak with the feather at the collar.
art_extra: The same woman as the sheet, forty-three years old: faint fine lines at the corners of the eyes, a lean adult face, not a girl's; the hair stays cream-coloured, not turned gold by the light.

name: 萨碧娜·雾桥
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_五_晚祷下.md:622
who: Sabina Mistbridge, a human bridge-guard of the lake kingdom, a night watch of the long bridge, twenty-two: about 174 cm, tall and strong. Reed-gold hair braided into one braid coiled at the back of her head, the Mistbridge house colour; thick brows, also a Mistbridge trait; eyes the green of new lakeside reeds, with a thin line at the corners from years of looking north. Cheeks wind-reddened over the cheekbones. A steady, patient, dutiful air.
build: 174 cm, tall and strong: broad shoulders and a strong back, a C-cup, a firm waist and sturdy hips.
palette: reed gold, lake green, deep blue, old wood brown, lamp-light amber
casual: Her bridge-guard clothes: a thick wool bridge cloak with a bridge embroidered on the collar over a dark blue wool tunic and trousers, leather boots; on her left arm (on the viewer's right when they face us) the old tower shield painted with a lake and a single star, patched twice at the edge; a long spear in her right hand with a bridge lamp hung from the shaft. A steady, watchful look.
private: A long-sleeved cream wool dress to the shins, thick stockings, house shoes, the braid unpinned over one shoulder; a needle and thread held in her hand. She stands, a quiet, tired look.
battle: A boiled leather cuirass over the blue tunic, leather vambraces, a plain steel cap, the old painted tower shield on her left arm (on the viewer's right when they face us), the long spear levelled in her right hand, the bridge lamp still on the shaft; feet planted wide, a steady, stern look.
formal: A long deep blue wool surcoat embroidered with a bridge at the collar and water at the cuffs, a silver brooch at the shoulder, the reed-gold braid coiled with a lake-blue ribbon; the spear held upright beside her. She stands straight with her chin lifted, a grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the green eyes looking north past the viewer, then turning to meet them with a steady, patient gaze, mouth closed. A bridge lamp's warm amber light from one side, cold lake mist behind. Foreground blur: mist and the spear shaft. She wears the thick bridge cloak with the bridge on the collar.

name: 埃德加
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_五_晚祷下.md:846
who: Edgar, king of the lake kingdom and the first Crown-Bearer, in his fifties: about 186 cm, thin and tall. Long grey-white hair tied back with a lake-blue silk ribbon, a face that always looks as if he has just woken up, pale lake-teal eyes that look slowly at everything before speaking. A slow, unhurried, patient air; he waits for the other side to speak first. At his left hip (on the viewer's right when they face us) a royal sword whose hilt is set not with a gem but with a shard of a stone ring dredged from the lakebed, which glows a pale cyan. Not wearing his own crown.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, tall man of about fifty, sleepy pale lake-teal eyes with a slow gaze, a long straight nose, thin brows, fine lines at the eyes, a mild closed mouth; keep the same flat anime style.
build: 186 cm, thin and tall, narrow shoulders, long hands.
palette: lake blue and teal, grey-white, pale silver, iron grey, soft cyan glow
casual: A long deep blue wool coat closed down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the cuffs embroidered with a ring of water, over a plain grey linen shirt and dark trousers, soft boots; the long grey-white hair tied back with a lake-blue silk ribbon; the royal sword sheathed at his hip with its hilt glowing pale cyan; an orange held in one hand. A sleepy, patient look.
private: A loose long-sleeved undyed wool house robe tied with a cord, soft slippers, the grey-white hair untied over his shoulders; an orange and a small knife in his hands. A mild, half-awake look.
battle: A lake-blue enamelled steel half-armor over the deep blue coat, a plain open steel helm, leather gauntlets, the royal sword drawn and held low in his right hand, its stone-ring hilt glowing pale cyan; a calm, unhurried, heavy look.
formal: The long deep blue coat edged with silver water-waves, a lake-blue ribbon in the hair, and on his head a plain iron crown with no gems; the royal sword sheathed at his hip with its cyan shard glowing. He stands unhurried, hands loosely before him, a sleepy, patient look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned a little, the pale lake-teal eyes looking at the viewer slowly, as if waiting for them to speak first, a faint closed-mouth smile. Soft cold lake light from one side, a faint cyan glow from the sword hilt below. Foreground blur: a peeled orange in his hand. He wears the deep blue coat with the lake-blue ribbon in his grey-white hair.

name: 伯特伦
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_五_晚祷下.md:877
who: Bertram, deputy envoy of Blackstone at the Ford of the Gods, in his fifties: about 184 cm, thin and tall. Smooth ash-blond hair combed straight back and thinning a little at the temples, pale hazel eyes, a thin courteous smile that never shows his teeth. A dark charcoal Blackstone wool robe with thin silver piping at the cuffs; before he speaks he always touches his sleeve cuff once. Soft hands without any calluses and fingernails trimmed perfectly even. A polite, calculating air; every sentence he says is true, but never the whole of it.
face: FACE, as in the references: a thin, smooth man of about fifty-five, pale hazel eyes with a courteous cool gaze, thin brows, faint lines at the eyes, a thin closed-mouth smile; keep the same flat anime style.
build: 184 cm, thin and tall, narrow shoulders and long soft hands.
palette: charcoal grey, thin silver, ash blond, pale hazel, black
casual: His embassy dress: a long charcoal-grey Blackstone wool robe closed down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the cuffs piped with a thin silver band, over a white linen shirt; black leather shoes, a small silver ring on one hand. One hand resting on the other cuff. A courteous, cool look.
private: A loose long-sleeved dark grey wool house robe over a shirt, no ring, soft slippers; a ledger held in one hand and one finger on his cuff. A quiet calculating look.
battle: He never does his own work: a heavy charcoal-grey travelling cloak with a fur collar over the robe, leather gloves, a rolled letter in one hand, the other hand on his cuff; a cool, measuring look.
battle_pose: 3) the scheming outfit: standing with one hand on his cuff and the other holding a rolled letter behind his back, the head slightly tilted, a thin courteous smile; he carries no weapon.
formal: A long black Blackstone wool robe closed with a silver chain-clasp and no buttons, thicker silver piping at cuffs and hem, a wide soft folded collar, a small silver chain across the chest hung with a bronze seven-ring wall pendant that glints coldly, his ash-blond hair freshly combed. He bows slightly with the hands folded, a polite smooth smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned a little, the pale hazel eyes looking at the viewer with a cool, courteous interest, his fingers just touching his silver-piped cuff, a thin closed-mouth smile. Cold grey window light from one side. Foreground blur: a blurred iron cage bar at the edge of the frame. He wears the charcoal-grey robe.

name: 洛蕾
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_五_晚祷下.md:919
who: Lorel, an elven flute-maker from the Emerald Crown forest across the lake, an ageless adult elf who looks about thirty: about 172 cm, tall and slender. Long silver-grey hair worn loose down her back, pointed elf ears, eyes of green-gold. Slender long fingers with thin calluses at the fingertips from making flutes. She looks at a person's hands first, then the face. A slow, spare, quiet air; she says half a sentence and leaves the other half.
build: 172 cm, tall and slender, long-limbed, a modest bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: silver-grey and moss green, green-gold, pale birch white, a little soft brown
casual: A long moss-green hooded cloak over a pale undyed linen tunic with long sleeves and a belted skirt to the shins, soft leaf-brown boots; the hood down; at her belt a small roll of carving tools, and in one hand a pale white-wood flute. A calm, unhurried look.
private: A loose long-sleeved cream linen dress, bare feet, the long silver-grey hair tied loosely at the nape, no cloak; a half-carved white-wood flute held in her fingers. A quiet, absorbed look.
battle: The moss-green cloak pulled around her, the hood half up, a leather travelling jerkin and leggings, soft boots, a slim elven bow slung on her back; she holds only the white-wood flute in front of her, a still, watchful look.
battle_pose: 3) the travelling outfit: standing straight and very still, the cloak pulled close and the white-wood flute held in front of her in both hands, the eyes steady and unblinking; she makes no move to fight.
formal: A long pale-silver silk gown with long sleeves and a soft round collar, embroidered with fine leaf-green thread at hem and cuffs, the thread glinting as if dewed, the moss-green cloak over it fastened with a leaf-shaped clasp, the silver-grey hair worn loose. She stands tall, hands folded around the white-wood flute, a composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the green-gold eyes looking at the viewer's hands first and then rising to meet their eyes, a faint closed-mouth smile. Soft cool lake mist light from one side. Foreground blur: a pale white-wood flute at the edge of the frame. She wears the moss-green hooded cloak.
